onboardingPromptText: New here? Let us walk you through creating your first board in a few steps.
onboardingStepBoard: Click here to create your first board.
onboardingStepAreas: Create two areas, e.g. "To do" and "Done".
onboardingStepCard: Add a card to one of your areas.
onboardingStepMove: Drag your card into another area.
onboardingStepInvite: Invite someone to collaborate on your board.

trelloImportHint: Paste a link to a Trello board to recreate it here. The board must be public (in Trello: Share → Change visibility → Public). Lists, cards, descriptions, checklists, comments, attachments and completion status are imported.
trelloErrorInvalidUrl: That doesn't look like a Trello board link.
trelloErrorNotAccessible: Couldn't read that board. Make sure the link is correct and the board is public.
trelloErrorEmpty: That board has no lists or cards to import.
settingsKeyAccessHint: Read-only keys can read boards but not create, change or delete anything (useful for AI agents).
presenceHereMany: {name} and {count} others are here right now
userTypeHint: AI agent accounts are for automations connecting over the API/MCP. They're marked with a bot icon so you can tell people and agents apart.
emailNotificationsHint: Turn off to stop the hourly summary of unread notifications. AI agent accounts have this off by default.
webhooksHint: Get notified in another system when something changes on a board. Each webhook is yours alone — other people on the same board have their own, and never see or trigger yours. Useful for waking an automation or AI agent when work appears.
webhooksEmpty: You haven't set up any webhooks yet.
